_comment: 240 named stable cluster sites, not 240 simultaneous creatures. Host streams around each peer; named optional encounters replace their reserved cluster rather than doubling it. Authoring measurements are not playable density or combat proof.
_comment_roster: Twelve owner species only. Aquaryn and Abyssal Guardian never random; Tidecoil named-only and never mount. First Shore uses Torrentoad and Mangrove Monitor to satisfy three roles; draft roster first_habitat metadata must follow this table or be renamed primary_habitat.
_comment_geometry: Positions sample radial_landing_sectors_v1 from water_heightfield.gd. Eight compass samples around spawn jitter footprint avoid dry grade >28 degrees and limit shallows to depth0.05..0.95m. Radius is spawn/roam jitter, not a certified combat arena. Reground after terrain/path edits and validate actor capsules.
_comment_tuning: Starting spawn budgets and radii. One actor per cluster limits visual noise. Runtime must cap active actors per peer neighborhood and prevent aggressive pursuit into safe anchors; measure real cadence.

named_encounters.combat_intent: A patient ranged defender uses the rock arch as cover; circling exposes its side.
A guarded counterattacker punishes frontal rushing; bait the claw and move around the basalt shelf.
An ambusher waits beside a damp gully; its long recovery rewards drawing the lunge onto dry footing.
A controller holds the ruined garden fringe; use the dry approach to break its ranged pressure.
A late apex sweeps the visible surface at the reef edge; prepare on the island and punish recovery between broad lateral attacks.
named_encounters.region_level_exception: Owner fixed Tidecoil level 54 apex; random Tether Current tables remain <=53.

validation_limitations: No render or traversal proof; Terrain3D bake may differ until parity test passes.
Safe camps/NPC/trainer placements are not yet fully composed; revalidate exclusions after integration.
Shallow footprint is spawn jitter, not complete monster body or combat arena certification.
Veilfall land candidates include ungraded high ground; intended hike and encounter spacing require runtime relocation after grading.
Night table weighting, named replacement ownership and streamed active cap require runtime consumer support.
